character.name: rest
character.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent rear-view upper-body character sprite for the foreground of a Slay the Spire campfire/rest-site screen. The reference defines the EXACT character identity and costume: a shadowy purple-skinned priest, long pale hair, tall golden Transcendence halo/circlet, broad upward crescent shoulder pauldrons with cyan-blue inlays, layered indigo-violet and muted gold ceremonial robes. Paint the SAME priest from BEHIND in a relaxed seated resting posture, turned very slightly to the RIGHT toward an offscreen campfire. Show the back of the ornate headdress, pale hair falling down the back, both broad armored shoulders, and upper back/robe. No visible face, no weapon, no staff, no hands necessary, no actual campfire, no ground, no scenery. Square canvas, centered bust filling about 90 percent of width and height, all headdress tips and shoulder tips fully contained with a small clear margin, robe continues naturally to the bottom edge. Hand-painted dark fantasy game art, broad readable shapes with clean silhouette, matching the attached sprite. Deep shadowed indigo materials with subdued gold trim; warm amber campfire rim light on the RIGHT shoulder and head edge, dim violet undertones. This is a foreground cutout with REAL alpha transparency, not a rectangular picture: everything outside the priest must be transparent, including gaps in the headdress. No text, no watermark, no frame.

character.name: heart_victory
character.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: full-screen Heart-victory ending illustration for a Slay the Spire Shadow Priest mod. Wide landscape 16:10 aspect ratio. Image 1 defines the protagonist's identity and costume; image 2 is only a reference for the game's painterly dramatic ending-art style and the Corrupt Heart, do not copy its Ironclad character, sword, cropped panel layout or orange fire. Paint a complete cinematic victory tableau: the SAME shadowy purple priest wearing the ornate golden Tier-2 Transcendence halo, cyan-inlaid crescent shoulders, pale flowing hair and layered indigo/gold ceremonial robes stands center-right, seen three-quarter from behind, one hand raised after delivering the final psychic blow. On the left, the enormous Corrupt Heart hangs defeated in the ruined gothic chamber, its stone-like red-black surface split by brilliant violet fissures and dissolving into ethereal dark shards and purple motes. No graphic gore, no blood spray. Thin ribbons of void energy draw away from the Heart and curl around the priest's hand. Through broken high arches beyond, a pale silver dawn breaks through the Spire's darkness, suggesting hard-won release. The priest is the clear heroic silhouette; the Heart and violet rupture are the secondary focal point. Epic but restrained Slay the Spire-style painted illustration, strong shapes, textured brushwork, limited indigo/amethyst/aged-gold palette and a little silver daylight. Keep important figures clear of the top and bottom 10 percent for screen cropping. Full-bleed finished artwork, no UI, no words, no victory title, no border, no speech bubbles, no additional heroes or legendary weapon.
